svg.title: Sairithik Komuravelly
svg.desc: Sairithik, in dot-matrix letters that change to Sai and then to heysai.dev. I build products, AI tooling, and the workflows that run them. Fast with AI, lost without it, with lost struck out and fluent written in by hand. A diagram shows one ticket fanning out to five research agents, merging, going through a three-agent debate and a review gate that sends it back once, then reaching a human.
